note: A 200 whose body is a gateway’s HTML rather than this wire — what a proxy in front of a provider answers when it is confused. A body that does not parse is a FAULT, and it must not read as a transient or, worse, as a picture (S-096, S-124). THE PATH IS THE ENTRY'S TEXT WIRE, because the call it answers is the canonical picture's and the canonical carries no reference (S-128); the BODY recorded here is untouched, and the classification it drives is the same on either wire.
